companies.name: Puget Energy, Inc.
companies.subsector: Regulated electricity and gas utility platform
companies.description: Puget Energy, Inc. is a Bellevue, Washington-based utility holding company whose core business is Puget Sound Energy, the regulated electric and natural gas utility serving western Washington. PSE is wholly owned by Puget Energy and serves approximately 1.26 million electric customers and 883,000 natural-gas customers across roughly 6,000 square miles in 10 counties. Puget LNG is a separate nonregulated subsidiary of Puget Energy. The platform is owned through Puget Holdings by BCI (20.9%), Macquarie Asset Management (15.8%), OMERS (23.9%), Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan (15.8%), AIMCo (13.6%) and PGGM (10.0%). No later sponsor transfer or signed pending platform sale was identified through August 23, 2026. Puget Sound Energy is retained as the regulated subsidiary and operating brand rather than counted as a separate PortCo.

companies.name: Alpha Generation, LLC
companies.subsector: Thermal generation infrastructure and independent power production
companies.description: Alpha Generation, LLC (AlphaGen) owns and operates 26 dispatchable power-generation facilities totaling approximately 14 GW across six U.S. states and the PJM, NYISO, ISO-NE and CAISO markets. The Houston-based platform serves wholesale electricity, capacity and ancillary-services markets through gas- and oil-fired generation assets. ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII formed AlphaGen in January 2024 and remains the controlling majority owner. ADIA holds a separately evidenced 16.8% indirect interest through Black Volt B 2024 LLC. CPP Investments completed a US$1.0 billion strategic minority investment through CPPIB AlphaGen US LLC on March 9, 2026. Exact ArcLight and CPP ownership percentages are not publicly disclosed, and no subsequent exit or pending sale was identified through August 12, 2026.

companies.name: Fengate-MedCraft Cleveland Clinic Outpatient Portfolio
aliases: U.S. Medical Outpatient Facilities Portfolio (MedCraft JV)
companies.description: Fengate-MedCraft Cleveland Clinic Outpatient Portfolio is a 24-facility medical-outpatient sale-leaseback portfolio across Ohio and Florida totaling more than 900,000 square feet. Fengate Asset Management and MedCraft Healthcare Real Estate acquired the portfolio in September 2025 through FG MC II Cleveland, LLC and location-specific title entities; public sources do not disclose their percentages or a deal-specific Fengate fund. Cleveland Clinic and title affiliates were the former fee owners and remain the principal tenant/operator under long-term leases. The portfolio is the first Fengate-MedCraft joint-venture acquisition and is distinct from Fengate's separate Project Lotus investment with Montecito. No later disposal, recapitalization, owner exit or signed ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.

companies.name: Montecito Medical Outpatient Portfolio
aliases: U.S. Medical Outpatient Facilities Portfolio (Montecito JV)
companies.description: Montecito Medical Outpatient Portfolio is the bounded 2025 Project Lotus sale-recapitalization of a national medical-outpatient portfolio. Fengate Asset Management invested through Fengate Infrastructure Fund IV and affiliated entities using FG MNTO I LOTUS, LLC, while Montecito Medical Real Estate retained equity; their percentages are not publicly disclosed. Fengate described 16 facilities in 10 states, while transaction-advisor and trade sources described 18 properties in 11 states totaling approximately 750,000 square feet and a US$323 million recapitalization with US$233 million of financing. The facilities were 100% leased at closing to health systems and physician groups. The record excludes Montecito's enterprise portfolio and Fengate's separate MedCraft/Cleveland Clinic portfolio. No later portfolio sale, owner exit or signed ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.

companies.name: Cleco Corporate Holdings LLC
companies.subsector: Regulated electric utility and wholesale generation
companies.description: Cleco Corporate Holdings LLC is the operating parent within the privately held Cleco Group utility platform, serving Louisiana through Cleco Power and related generation assets. The regulated utility serves approximately 298,000 customers across 24 Louisiana parishes and owns eight generating units with 2,676 MW of rated capacity, supported by transmission and distribution networks and approved tariffs. Macquarie Asset Management, BCI and Manulife completed the take-private acquisition on April 13, 2016 and remain the legal owners; their last publicly confirmed 2020 interests were 53.9%, 36.9% and 9.2%, respectively, while exact current percentages are not publicly disclosed. A signed agreement announced April 27, 2026 would sell 100% of Cleco Group to Pine JV Holdings LLC, backed by Stonepeak and Bernhard Capital Partners, but the regulatory proceedings remained open through August 19, 2026, so the existing owners remain active pending closing.
